data.name: Niliyyah
data.gender_notes: Niliyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nil' meaning night and 'yah' meaning God. Niliyyah signifies the light of God that illuminates the night. The name Niliyyah carries the meaning “Light of the night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Niliyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the night and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niliyyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Niliyyah can be interpreted as a reminder of the importance of seeking guidance and light from God during times of darkness or uncertainty. In Islamic culture, the idea of night representing a time of spiritual reflection and seeking of knowledge is deeply rooted. Niliyyah, thus, signifies the commitment to continue the journey of learning and growth despite the challenges presented by the night (or the trials of life).
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Niliyyah brings forth the concept of Tawakkul or trust in God's wisdom and power. It reminds us that even in the darkest of moments, God's light is present and shining to guide us. It calls us to have faith and trust in God's plan for our lives and to continuously seek His guidance and support. Ultimately, the name Niliyyah serves as a reminder of our dependence on Allah, and our unwavering belief in His influence and presence in every moment of our lives.
